rateLimits.note: Stated on the Ensembl REST wiki and sent as X-RateLimit-Limit 55000 / X-RateLimit-Period 3600; beyond: 429 with Retry-After (seconds, float), no call until it has passed.
The wiki gives it as the average the hourly figure allows; the Ensembl REST paper (Yates et al., Bioinformatics 2015, PMC4271150) states a cap of 15 requests a second.

attribution.text: Ensembl (EMBL-EBI); cite the current Ensembl paper

provenance.notes: Read 2026-11-10: the REST wiki Rate-Limits page (per IP address, X-RateLimit-* headers, 429 + Retry-After), the live headers (X-RateLimit-Limit 55000, Period 3600), the Ensembl disclaimer (no restriction on access to or use of the data; third-party constraints may apply) and the EMBL-EBI terms of use (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/about/terms-of-use: attribution expected, usage that hinders the service gets blocked). attribution.required follows the EMBL-EBI terms; the disclaimer itself names no licence.
